stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

2. Parse exact dimensions and compare input/output geometry before proposing a rule. Match all target placements against the original input, collect and deduplicate their cells, then apply changes; do not let earlier edits create new matches. Check that this procedure reproduces every demo's changed-cell mask before using it on the test.
